Taylor: Quick thread	6 compact playground streaming glitches. On small widths the token pill jumps horizontally when partial chunks come in, and the stop/regenerate chip drops underneath the quick-actions row. Also noticed that selecting a prompt from the drawer pauses the stream and sometimes restarts it. Attaching screencap.
Jordan: dropped: https://files.internal/s/mini-playground-glitch.png	6 I can repro on iPhone SE emulation.
Rae: Re: token pill	6 can we make it monospaced and reserve width? If digits change width layout jumps less. Also consider throttling visual updates so we don't update on every websocket chunk.
Min: Throttling SGTM. Backend sends chunks ~every 30-80ms; client-side throttle to 100-200ms should smooth things without noticeable lag.
Chris: On prompt drawer: current insertion triggers a full composer rehydrate which tears down the stream. We should instead call an insertText API that updates the model input without closing the stream socket.
Taylor: UX question: floating stop chip vs collapsing quick-actions. Which is more discoverable? Mobile UX priority = obvious stop affordance.
Jordan: Floating stop chip wins for discoverability. It should be circular, 44px, top-right of the message frame, and hide when stream idle. Add slight shadow so it floats over quick-actions.
Rae: Copy + a11y: visible label can be icon-only, but aria-label should be "Stop generation". For regenerate, label = "Regenerate response". Keep visible microcopy short.
accessibility-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure the floating stop is focusable (tabindex=0), shows a clear focus ring, and has a keyboard shortcut (e.g., Esc to stop). Also add aria-live="polite" for streaming chunks and a separate control "Announce latest" to let screen reader users replay the last chunk.
Min: CSS snippet proposal to reserve token pill width: ```css .token-pill { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; min-width: 5ch; text-align: right; } ``` This plus throttling should stop the horizontal jump.
Chris: I'll implement minimal DOM patch for prompt inserts so the stream session id stays intact. Also will add client debounce for token updates at 120ms.
Taylor: Design request: mock the floating stop with both light/dark and high-contrast. When the token pill hits 80% of quota, change its color to warn and announce via aria-live: "Token usage: 820 of 1024 tokens used (80%)".
Rae: We'll test zoom 200% and TalkBack/VoiceOver flows. Also confirm regen keyboard flow (focus order) doesn't hide the composer toolbar.
Jordan: Pairing: I'll work with Chris on the insertText flow tomorrow. Rae and I will mock the floating chip variants this afternoon.
accessibility-bot: Prototype link: https://playground.internal/proto/mini-stop-regen-2026 (includes keyboard tests).
Taylor: Plan summary: 1) make token pill monospaced + min-width, 2) add client-side throttle to token updates (~120ms), 3) implement insertText to avoid stream restart, 4) add floating stop chip with 44px touch target + aria-labels, 5) add "Announce latest" control.
Min: I'll open a PR for throttle + token UI tonight.
Chris: I'll PR the insertText + keep-session change.
Rae: I'll add a11y acceptance criteria to the ticket and run manual checks once PRs land.
Taylor: Thanks team. We'll ship to small beta after prototype checks pass. Keeping this thread open for updates.
